citation: Sterne JAC, Higgins JPT, et al. ROBINS-I V2: Risk Of Bias In Non-randomized Studies - of Interventions, version 2 (revised draft, 20 November 2025). riskofbias.info. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
source_notes: Domain 3, question 3.1: the flowchart labels the substantial-risk branch 'SY', but the response options of 3.1 are Y/PY/WN/SN/NI and question 3.6 is asked 'If SN to 3.1'; SN is used.
Domain 4, question 4.4: the official condition reads 'If N/PN/NI to 4.1, 4.4 or 4.4'; read as 4.1, 4.2 or 4.3 (consistent with the flowchart).
Several Moderate (or Serious) domains may justify a Serious (or Critical) overall judgement (official table); the system suggests the worst domain and warns, the reviewer decides.
